# T-1: Add prepare analysis scan

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Run docs scan during flow preparation and make analysis.json a required classifier input.

## Acceptance Criteria
- prepare-spec runs docs scan after the active flow root is established.
- Missing, unreadable, or invalid analysis.json fails prepare.
- Invalid .sdd-forge/config.json fails as invalid config and is not downgraded to missing config.
- src/docs/lib/analysis-entry.js exposes iterateAnalysisCategories(analysis,{strict}) and shared metadata keys.
- All top-level analysis category walkers use the shared iterator, including docs enrich/text/review and analysis-filter.
- Unit tests cover scan failure and invalid analysis shape.

## Implementation Notes
Update run-prepare-spec.js and add a shared analysis category iterator with strict mode for regression. Accepted category objects contain entries[], optional summary, and optional dataSourceHash; metadata keys analyzedAt, enrichedAt, and generatedAt are ignored. Keep check scan metadata handling aligned through the shared helper.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests with fixture analysis.json variants and a prepare-spec failure fixture.
